author: M15Gamer
quote: Honestly, GTA VI was a huge disappointment for me. It’s packed with glitches, and the game runs way too slow—it honestly feels more like an emulator than an actual GTA game. There isn’t even a performance mode option, so you can’t play it at 60 FPS. On top of that, it feels loaded with agendas!! and this is just not the Rockstar we’re used to seeing.
